| description = Has a solid regen. Found all over skyshrine entry room and fountain room area. Possibly mislabeled as "a gargoyle guardian". PLEASE ADD DROPS and link to [[a Gargoyle Guardian]]'s page if there is an error with the naming, maybe a redirect if all loot is the same.

Addition: There is a gargoyle guard in a back room by the bank area, in the same room is one of the invisible crystal spiders. A gargoyle guard has substantially more HP - on par with Kael's 4-way Storm Giants - and hits much harder than a gargoyle guardian. They WILL social aggro if you attack a crystal spider sitting next to them. Dark green at 60.
